description: Feature which has a point geometry and represents the locations where pedestrians and / or vehicles can enter or exit a building.

osid.description: Primary identifier for the feature. The OSID is a Globally Unique Identifier (GUID) and requires no centralised authority to ensure uniqueness. Note that the same OSID can occur in more than one feature type when a single feature is represented multiple times in the OS NGD.

versiondate.description: Date when the version was last updated.

versionavailablefromdate.description: The date this version of the feature became the latest version.

versionavailabletodate.description: The date this version of the feature was superseded by an update or ceased to exist.

changetype.description: The type of change that generated a new version of the feature.
enum: Moved From A Different Feature Type
Moved To A Different Feature Type

geometry_evidencedate.description: The date on which the latest evidence was gathered to make an update if required. For example, the date of a field visit or the date of imagery capture.

geometry_updatedate.description: Date when the geometry was last updated.

geometry_capturemethod.description: The capture method describes how the Building Access Location attributes were created, for example, via Field Survey.

theme.description: The OS NGD Theme to which the feature belongs.

description.description: A single descriptive value intended for a quick understanding of what the feature represents.

access_mode.description: A description of the method(s) of access normally utilised at the Building Access Location (for example, Pedestrian).

access_purpose.description: A description of the principal access function at the Building Access Location (for example, Private or Public).

access_obstruction.description: An indicator of possible accessibility obstruction(s) at the Building Access Location (for example, Ramp or Step).

access_level.description: An indicator of the relative location of the Building Access Location with respect to surface level upon approach to the Building Access Location (for example, Above Surface Level).

access_evidencedate.description: The date on which the latest evidence was gathered to make an update if required. For example, the date of a field visit or the date of imagery capture.

access_updatedate.description: Date when the access was last updated.

accessedbuildingid.description: Identifier of the Building associated with the Building Access Location.
